_about: Public-domain Henry A. Brann, Catholic priest of New York, for the Word Hoard: Curious Questions, Gladstone and the Irish Grievances, his life of Archbishop John Hughes, Waifs and Strays (his sermons, lectures and essays), and his History of the American College in Rome. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 127 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
